gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was GBP 95.413m and closed the year at GBP 180.123m. The report does not provide a single explicit aggregate quantified prior-year reserve movement figure; narrative highlights that prudent prior reserving enabled releases in earlier periods while 2016 experienced a series of large catastrophe losses (eg Hurricane Matthew, Alberta fires, New Zealand Earthquake) which materially impacted results. The technical reserves note and claims development tables are present but no unambiguous aggregate prior-year strengthening/release number is stated.
